deviations: stepStory keeps inApp: false on a cold-loaded deep link entry. The frozen transitions.stepStory always writes inApp: true, so after Newer or Older on a cold deep link the close would call history.back() and leave the site, which the brief forbids. story.ts overrides only that field of the op it applies; routes.ts is untouched. Proven by story.test.ts 'closing replaces the deep link with / on the same entry, never going back'.
The 404 page gets title, description and robots noindex only: no canonical, og:url or og:image (it is noindex, never shared, and /404.html has no trailing-slash form).
/resume/ uses og:type website (the brief names profile for / and article for exhibit pages only).

A7 JS-off state: Playwright refuses page.evaluate in a context with javaScriptEnabled false, so axe cannot run there. The spec serves /exhibit/verafin/ through page.route with every <script> removed and the <noscript> wrapper unwrapped (the JS-off rendering, with the production CSS and headers), asserts no data-mode, #app hidden and story-static visible, then runs axe. Spec (e) runs with JavaScript really disabled.

openStory sets history.scrollRestoration to 'manual' for the gallery entry while pushing (the pattern navigation.ts uses for wings), so Back does not restore a stale scroll after the close has scrolled to the exhibit's section.
The story scroller is a focusable region (tabindex 0, labelled by the title) for axe scrollable-region-focusable when a story has no links.
ui.module.css is emitted after ExhibitDialog.module.css in the bundle, so overrides of composed control rules carry a .dialog prefix.
The desktop panel uses right: calc(100% - 100vw) so it is flush with the window edge despite the root's stable scrollbar gutter.
Added a Lucide 'check' icon to src/overlay/icons.tsx for 'Link copied'.
